sections.heading: Create your data model
sections.content:
A request body can be declared with a Pydantic model. FastAPI validates the incoming data and returns clear validation errors.

The same model also contributes its schema to the generated OpenAPI documentation.

code_blocks.code:
from pydantic import BaseModel

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: FastAPI reads JSON from the request body, converts data when possible, validates it, and provides the parsed model to the path operation.
